description: Code as policy: a confined agent session (same agent family as you, ASPIRE fix-loop discipline) writes and iterates a controller program for this task from the task documents, the real demonstrations and the experience selected for this task, guided by your `brief` (what to build, what to borrow, what to avoid). It runs its numbered versions on the development starts (each version = one development evaluation of the campaign) and returns its best version as a candidate with that evaluation. Use it for a scripted solution, a teacher for record_demos, or a stage of a composition. start_from: an earlier program candidate to improve.

costs.all: one session (hours, default 3); each numbered version = 1 development evaluation; no training episodes
